strings.name: Zhu Ting
strings.summary: Zhu Ting became a leading Chinese outside hitter through high attacking contact, all-round skills and decisive scoring. Olympic gold and MVP in 2016 were followed by further international club success, alongside recovery from wrist injury and surgery. She joined Conegliano in 2024, winning the 2025 Champions League and Italian titles in 2025 and 2026. She remained for 2026–27, her third season at the club.

strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.highlights.h1.title: National-team leadership
strings.highlights.h1.text: Rio Olympic gold and MVP in 2016, plus World Cup titles and MVPs in 2015 and 2019, reflect her national-team contribution.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education and early training
strings.facts.f2.value: Grew up in a rural family, entered sports school in 2007 and began professional volleyball training in Henan in 2008.
strings.highlights.h2.title: International club achievements
strings.highlights.h2.text: Won two Champions Leagues with VakıfBank and the 2025 title with Conegliano, carrying experience across leagues.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Stayed at Conegliano
strings.timeline.t1.text: The club confirmed its number-four outside hitter for 2026–27, her third consecutive season.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Joined Conegliano
strings.timeline.t2.text: Moved from Scandicci to the Italian club and subsequently won Club World, Champions League and domestic titles.
strings.timeline.t3.title: European return after surgery
strings.timeline.t3.text: Joined Scandicci after wrist surgery and recovery, rebuilt match form and helped win the CEV Cup.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Injury at the Tokyo Games
strings.timeline.t4.text: Wrist trouble affected her Olympics as China exited in the group stage; she then paused competition for treatment.
strings.timeline.t5.title: World Cup retained
strings.timeline.t5.text: Helped China win the World Cup and took MVP, then returned from Turkey to play for Tianjin.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Olympic gold and Turkish chapter
strings.timeline.t6.text: Won Rio gold and MVP with China and joined VakıfBank for a three-year professional spell.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Junior and senior breakthroughs
strings.timeline.t7.text: Won the World Junior title and MVP and entered the senior national team that year, developing into a leading outside hitter.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Henan training entry
strings.timeline.t8.text: Began professional volleyball training in Henan, developing technique and competition experience before national-team progression.
